content.text: Do these steps in order. 1) Write me one short sentence saying you are starting. 2) Use the python tool to run exactly: `print("cell one")`. 3) Write me one short sentence about the result. 4) Now, WITHOUT any tool, think very carefully and at length: list by hand every 5-digit number whose digits are strictly increasing and whose digit sum is 25, and count them, double-checking each one twice. 5) Write the list and your count to me. 6) Only then use the python tool to verify the count. 7) Reply with the verified count.
